claims.text: Many reviewers find the applicator bottle effective for applying shampoo, oils, and hair dye directly to the scalp, with several noting it helps reduce product waste.
A recurring complaint is that the tip or top cracks, splits, or leaks during use, sometimes within days.
Some reviewers report the measurement markings are hard to see, unlike the product photos.
Several reviewers describe the bottle as sturdy and well-made, while others call it brittle or cheap.
Reviewers appreciate the easy-to-squeeze, reusable design and the narrow nozzle for controlled application.
